input_text.prompt_instructions: input the <input> labelled 'Username', at xpath html/body/div/div/div[2]/div[1]/div/div/form/div[1]/input, receiving 'standard_user'
input the <input> labelled 'Password', at xpath html/body/div/div/div[2]/div[1]/div/div/form/div[2]/input, receiving 'secret_sauce'

click_element.prompt_instructions: click the <button> labelled 'Add to cart', at xpath html/body/div[1]/div/div/div/div/div/div/div[1]/div[2]/div[2]/button
click the <a> labelled 'Cart, 1 items', at xpath html/body/div[1]/div/div/header/div[1]/div[3]/a
click the <button> labelled 'Checkout', #2 among its same-tag siblings, at xpath html/body/div[1]/div/div/div/div/div[2]/button[2]

input_text.prompt_instructions: input the <input> labelled 'First Name', at xpath html/body/div[1]/div/div/div/div/form/div[1]/div[1]/input, receiving 'John'
input the <input> labelled 'Last Name', at xpath html/body/div[1]/div/div/div/div/form/div[1]/div[2]/input, receiving 'Doe'
input the <input> labelled 'Zip/Postal Code', at xpath html/body/div[1]/div/div/div/div/form/div[1]/div[3]/input, receiving '12345'
